Subject: Request: legal name, signers & PO routing details for Garnet profile

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to start provisioning Garnet Labs in our vendor registry so Finance and Procurement can issue POs on day one. To speed things up I attached our single-page onboarding form; if you can return the completed PDF and a tax document (W-9 or W-8 as applicable) that will unblock the creation.

Quick checklist (short):
- Legal entity name used for contracts and tax paperwork
- Registered address & mailing address (if different)
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) for invoice ingestion
- Preferred PO routing / ERP code (if you map POs back to an internal code)
- Authorized signer(s) and their titles (who can sign SOWs >$25k)
- Remittance instructions / bank name (we can store in the finance system after initial profile setup)

If you prefer, you can send the scan of the W-9 and a quick reply with the contact details; I'll follow up with Procurement for ERP mapping. Our target is to have Garnet live for POs by 11/24.

Appreciate it —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Strategic Partnerships
